falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern assumed a volatility compression and gradual normalization; sustained extreme fear would indicate this is a deeper liquidation event, not a bottoming pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below 4200
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal a flight-to-safety recession panic rather than the soft-landing/growth-scare bottom the pattern implies; rates and equities would be sending contradictory signals to the 2024 August playbook

falsification_conditions.condition: Credit spreads (HY OAS) widen beyond 500 basis points
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug featured contained credit stress (~400bps peak); exceeding 500bps would indicate systemic credit event risk, invalidating the pattern's assumption of contained corporate stress and liquidity-driven recovery

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
